issues.legal_issue: The requirement of prior judicial permission for a natural guardian to transfer a minor’s immovable property does not apply to a transfer by the manager of joint family property that includes the minor’s undivided interest.
material_facts: The property sold was joint family property in which the minors had undivided interests and was managed by an adult family member acting as the family manager.
The adult family manager executed the sale deed, joined by two widows in their individual capacities and as guardians of the minor family members.
The courts below found that the family manager acted in that capacity and that the widows’ participation did not show that the minors had acquired divided interests before or at the time of the sale.
The appeal sought to invalidate the sale on the ground that the required permission to transfer the minors’ interests had not been obtained.
issues.conclusion: Prior judicial permission was not required for the family manager’s sale of joint family property insofar as it included the minors’ undivided interests. The widows’ joining the sale deed did not establish that the interests were divided, so the permission requirement did not provide a basis to invalidate the sale.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 6, 8 and 12 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956, must be read together. Section 6 excludes a minor’s undivided interest in joint family property from the property for which a natural guardian is contemplated; Section 12 ordinarily bars appointment of a guardian for that interest when an adult family member manages the property; and Section 8’s permission requirement applies to a natural guardian’s disposition of the minor’s property, not to a family manager’s disposition of the minor’s undivided interest in joint family property. The adult family member managing the property need not be the Karta. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: joint_family_sale_appeal and minor_undivided_interest and adult_family_management and sale_by_family_manager

predicates.joint_family_sale_appeal: The proceeding challenges a sale or disposition of joint family property.
predicates.minor_undivided_interest: A minor had an undivided interest in the joint family property involved in the disposition.
predicates.adult_family_management: An adult family member managed the joint family property.
predicates.sale_by_family_manager: The adult family member managing the property made the challenged disposition on behalf of the family.

issues.definition: When a challenged joint family property sale involves a minor’s undivided interest and is made by the adult family manager, prior permission is not required for that transfer.
